notes:
You can now future-date customer payments in 2.0.0-beta.85 (SWITQBCompanion_WindowsApp_2.0.0-beta.85.zip). All tests pass.

How far ahead: a customer payment can be dated up to 90 days ahead, for post-dated cheques or transfers set for a later day. The calendar now lets you pick dates past today, and changing a saved payment’s date works the same way.
The setting: it uses the same setting as payments out, Settings → Requisitions and approvals → Furthest payment date ahead (days) (MaxFuturePaymentDays). Changing it changes the limit for both. Setting it to 0 means no dates after today.
Past the limit: the app refuses the date and shows the last date allowed.
In QuickBooks: the payment goes in with the date you entered.
Lodging: a post-dated payment can’t go into a lodgement dated earlier than the payment.
